verdict.rationale: The evidence covers managing seller payouts through the Dashboard or API, setting payout schedules in the test environment, and accelerating settlement timeframes. None of it documents holding seller funds in a balance until delivery or dispute windows pass, releasing on a trigger, or the limits of any escrow-like mechanics. General payout scheduling is an adjacent feature, not the escrow-style hold-and-release capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, funds can wait — hold seller funds in a balance until delivery or dispute windows pass, release on my schedule or trigger, with the escrow-like mechanics and their limits documented
